name: Liquid (Gl)ass
tagline: 为 iOS 14–17 的系统界面带来实时液态玻璃视觉效果。
description: Liquid (Gl)ass 可为 Dock、文件夹、App 资源库、锁屏通知与音乐卡片、快捷操作、时钟、键盘、标签栏和系统弹窗等界面加入动态玻璃质感。
你可以分别控制支持的系统组件，并调整折射、色散、明暗色调与高光效果。
本包由 Banana 根据 winaviation/dylv 的 GPL-3.0 开源项目构建并提供安装镜像，非 Banana 原创。
notice: ⚠️ 上游已确认支持 iOS 14–17，iOS 18 暂未验证。首次安装后请执行一次 Userspace Reboot。大量同时启用的实时玻璃效果可能增加 GPU 占用。
features: 为多种系统界面提供实时液态玻璃效果
支持折射、色散、明暗色调与自适应高光
可分别启用和调整不同系统组件
改善界面转场及关闭插件后的系统材质恢复
提供 Rootless 与 RootHide 软件包
usage: 根据越狱环境安装 Rootless 或 RootHide 软件包。
首次安装后执行一次 Userspace Reboot。
打开系统“设置”中的 Liquid (Gl)ass，选择需要启用的界面并调整效果。
如出现掉帧或耗电增加，请减少同时启用的组件。

changes: 新增重新设计的实时液态玻璃效果。
增强系统界面覆盖、折射、色调、高光与转场表现。
优化空闲性能及关闭插件后的系统材质恢复。

en.name: Liquid (Gl)ass
en.tagline: Live liquid-glass styling for system interfaces on iOS 14–17.
description: Liquid (Gl)ass adds dynamic glass styling to the Dock, folders, App Library, Lock Screen notifications and media cards, quick actions, clocks, keyboards, tab bars, system alerts, and other supported surfaces.
Supported surfaces can be controlled individually with adjustable refraction, chromatic dispersion, light and dark tints, and highlights.
This package is built and mirrored by Banana from the GPL-3.0 open-source project by winaviation/dylv. Banana is not the original developer.
en.notice: ⚠️ Upstream confirms iOS 14–17 support; iOS 18 is not yet verified. Perform one Userspace Reboot after the first installation. Enabling many live-glass surfaces at once may increase GPU usage.
features: Live liquid-glass styling across multiple system surfaces
Refraction, chromatic dispersion, light and dark tints, and adaptive highlights
Individual controls for supported system components
Improved transitions and stock-material restoration after disabling the tweak
usage: Install the Rootless or RootHide package matching your jailbreak environment.
Perform one Userspace Reboot after the first installation.
Open Liquid (Gl)ass in Settings and select the desired surfaces and appearance.
Reduce the number of enabled surfaces if animation smoothness or battery life is affected.

changes: Expanded system-surface coverage and improved refraction, tint, highlights, and transitions.
Optimized idle performance and stock-material restoration after disabling the tweak.
